description: This file defines options and filtering mechanisms for the go.uber.org/goleak package, used for detecting goroutine leaks in tests. It includes configuration options, default filters, and functions to ignore specific goroutines based on their stack traces.

classes.name: opts
classes.description: Configuration options for goroutine leak detection, including filters, retries, sleep duration, and cleanup function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the options from an Option to the opts struct.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a stack based on the configured filters.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Determines whether to retry based on the current attempt index and maxRetries.
